statement_zh: 李立新自述，本书是在其博士论文《造物之迹——中国设计艺术史引论》的基础上修改完成的。
statement_en: Li Lixin states that the present book was revised and completed on the basis of his doctoral dissertation, Zaowu Zhi Ji: An Introduction to the History of Chinese Design Art.

statement_zh: 李立新的博士论文于2002年6月15日在东南大学艺术学系通过答辩。
statement_en: Li Lixin's doctoral dissertation was defended and passed at the Department of Art Studies, Southeast University, on 15 June 2002.
